claim.text: Retrieval is doing real work. Closed-book (no retrieval) scores 0.45 task accuracy; the same model with hybrid RAG scores 0.63 — a +18-point lift.

result.summary: The harness reproduces: with providers pinned to those in the published run where they still exist, accuracy is within 0.02, macro-F1 within 0.01, faithfulness within 0.01, retrieval within 0.01 and citation accuracy within 0.04 of the published values. The +18-point accuracy lift is measured against a closed-book baseline that scores below always answering 'yes'; against that trivial baseline the RAG lift is +0.00 to +0.04, within one standard error (n=150, SE 0.040). On macro-F1, which the report also publishes, retrieval clearly beats every trivial baseline (+0.16 to +0.18). No harness measurement error was found; every finding concerns reporting.

findings.finding: The TL;DR leads with an accuracy lift (+18) measured against a closed-book baseline that loses to always-yes; macro-F1, published alongside, shows the clear lift.
No trivial baseline appears anywhere in REPORT.md or the README, on either metric.
Faithfulness is computed on judged answers only (75-97% of 150, depending on model) and does not state its coverage; when retrieval fails the system abstains rather than staying faithful.
Faithfulness and correctness are weakly associated (phi 0.08-0.22): 71-86% of wrong answers are judged faithful.

Citation accuracy is judge-dependent (largest change in a model's mean 0.14 across three cross-family judges); faithfulness and hallucination are robust (largest change 0.03). The single-judge limitation was flagged in the report but not quantified.

Unpinned routing sent all four generators to providers other than the published ones, and the judge provider was not recorded; deepseek/deepseek-v3.2 returned HTTP 410 on the published route about four months after the commit, so the published run cannot be exactly reproduced.

not_performed: C1-C4: not applicable; the target is a one-off research harness with no archive, no persisted production output and a fixed corpus.

cost.note: Gateway-reported spend over 5 runs (1 discarded). Elapsed time from clone to findings about 8.5 hours, alongside other work; auditor time not recorded.
